remarks: Welcome to 225 Falls Road in West Falls, located within the desirable East Aurora School District! This three bedroom, two full bathroom home offers an appealing combination of interesting architectural details, comfortable living spaces, and a peaceful wooded setting. Offering 1,002 square feet of living space on the main level, the home features an eat in kitchen that opens to a spacious living and dining area with vaulted ceilings, exposed wood beams, and large windows overlooking the surrounding landscape. The open layout creates an inviting atmosphere, while the abundance of natural light and wood accents add warmth and character throughout. All three bedrooms are conveniently located on the main floor (one being a walkthrough bedroom), along with a full bathroom. The partially finished lower level offers additional space for recreation, entertaining, or hobbies, complete with a wood burning fireplace, a second full bathroom, laundry area, and a distinctive spiral staircase connecting the two levels. Outside, a generous rear deck overlooks the wooded surroundings, providing an excellent setting to relax and enjoy the outdoors. Additional features include vinyl siding, public water, gas hot water baseboard heat, and a tankless hot water heater. With its unique layout, architectural character, and scenic surroundings, this property presents an opportunity to make a home your own in the East Aurora School District. Some updating is needed, but the home offers plenty of appealing features and possibilities for its next owner! The seller is open to private financing. Offers will be reviewed 10/21 at 1:00PM. Open House 10/18 from 1:00-3:00PM.
